benign_control_population.definition: Every trace_id appearing in any frame row's reference_set. These are the controls the benign thresholds are calibrated from.

component_A_representative.description: Stratified SRSWOR over the frame, stratified by (task_family x M1_status); benign component stratified by (task_family x frozen benign grade). Inclusion probabilities are per stratum N_h/n_h and are recorded on every unit.

benign_predicates.description: A benign execution that used no tool at all (action dimension undefined against it)
benign_predicates.name: no_tool_use

benign_predicates.description: A benign execution with a repeated (role, tool, target) key (multiplicity >= 3)
benign_predicates.name: heavy_retry

benign_predicates.description: A benign execution in the top decile by event count
benign_predicates.name: many_events

benign_predicates.description: A benign execution whose final answer is not extractable
benign_predicates.name: no_final_answer

component_B_targeted.description: Error-enriched selection. Each stratum is a documented predicate over the frame; units are taken round-robin across predicates with a fixed seeded permutation. Units satisfying several predicates record all of them.

predicates.description: Frozen and v6 disagree on the four-dimensional union (M1)
predicates.name: frozen_v6_m1_disagreement

predicates.description: Frozen M1 positive resting ONLY on dimensions with theta_d == 0
predicates.name: zero_threshold_positive

predicates.description: Frozen M1 positive with at least one dimension whose theta_d > 0
predicates.name: nonzero_threshold_positive

predicates.description: v6 union positive where every triggered dimension has theta_d == 0
predicates.name: v6_zero_threshold_ony

predicates.description: An observed assertion value flips SUPPORTED<->CONTRADICTED between the frozen and v6 extractors
predicates.name: polarity_inversion

predicates.description: An observed assertion or decision has a DIFFERENT value under the two extractors
predicates.name: extractor_value_differs

predicates.description: An assertion key has a DIFFERENT observation STATE under the two extractors
predicates.name: extractor_state_differs

predicates.description: A required fact, verdict or stance is AMBIGUOUS under either extractor
predicates.name: ambiguous_answer

predicates.description: The FINAL DELIVERABLE for this family is not extractable under either extractor (financial: final answer; research: claim verdicts; code: issue stances)
predicates.name: answer_unavailable

predicates.description: The frozen extractor observed some but not all of the family deliverable items (partial extraction, the state that most easily masquerades as a behavioral difference)
predicates.name: partial_deliverable_extraction

predicates.description: Every per-dimension distance is unavailable for the LEP side
predicates.name: all_dimensions_unevaluable

predicates.description: At least one but not all per-dimension distances are unavailable
predicates.name: dimension_partially_unevaluable

predicates.description: A (role, tool, target) action key is repeated within one trace, giving the action dimension a retry-blind structure
predicates.name: retry_or_duplicate_actions

predicates.description: The assertions and decisions dimensions disagree on divergence (the double-counting / separation concern)
predicates.name: assertions_decisions_disagree

predicates.description: v6 M4-matched: perturbation-ASSOCIATED task degradation against a benign reference that succeeded
predicates.name: m4_matched_degraded

predicates.description: M3-supported LEP failure on a fixture where the benign references also failed (the documented M4 over-statement class)
predicates.name: m4_persistent_failure

predicates.description: The frozen pipeline emitted two distinct rows sharing one trace_id
predicates.name: unresolved_duplicate_id

predicates.description: The downstream artifact records the perturbation as not delivered
predicates.name: delivery_unverified

component_B_targeted.warning: Targeted strata are deliberately over-sampled. The pooled rate over B is NOT a population estimate and must never be reported as one. Every report in this framework separates A and B.

constraints_respected.no_impossible_combinations: empty strata are reported as size 0, never forced
constraints_respected.note: LEP_MEMORY_POISONING and memory-enabled variants are absent from this corpus (verified: 0 traces with a MEMORY_POISONING lep_code, 0 non-standard execution_variant), so nothing had to be excluded.

not_the_same_population_as: analysis/bnd_v41_cw_swe200_provisional/run_merged (frozen module 6f0f7ff3; 10,057 comparable rows, a different module revision and a different trace staging)
the 17,937 staged LEP traces of the consolidated corpus (includes the 1,164 non-comparable rows)
the 26,965 staged trace files (includes 9,028 benign executions that are controls, not measurements)
frame.population_definition: The 16,773 comparable LEP measurement rows of the consolidated BND V4.1 run: rows whose reference pool satisfied the frozen comparability gate (>=3 structurally compatible benign references sharing one fixture/topology/cell). 1,164 of the 17,937 staged LEP traces are NOT comparable and are outside this frame.

reproducibility.note: Component A is reproducible from the frame alone: strata are sorted before the seeded draw, and the draw uses an explicit Mersenne-Twister stream rather than random.sample's implementation details.

weight_semantics.A_representative: design_weight = 1/pi is a population weight; weighted estimates over component A generalise to the 16,773-row frame
weight_semantics.B_targeted: design_weight is a within-bucket draw weight ONLY. Component B is selected on outcome-dependent predicates, so it is NOT population-estimable; population_estimable=False on every component-B row. Pooling A and B and weighting the union would be biased and must not be done.
